title: FrontendPluginRuntimeContract
description: Formal contract for dynamic frontend plugin registration, sandboxed context, and keyring vault isolation

PluginManifest.description: Metadata and entrypoint definition for third-party OpenSanctuary frontend plugins

id.description: Unique plugin identifier (used for vault isolation and registry keys)

name.description: Human-readable display name of the plugin

version.description: Semantic version string of the plugin package

description.description: Brief description of the plugin's purpose and functionality

author.description: Author or organization providing the plugin

PluginKeyringVault.description: Isolated cryptographic vault injected into plugin runtime context

service.description: Service namespace enforcing plugin secret isolation

PLUGIN_KEYRING_PREFIX.description: Required namespace prefix for all plugin credential isolation vaults

CRASH_BOUNDARY_ENABLED.description: Host must trap third-party plugin init() and hook exceptions to prevent application crash

ROOT_KEYRING_MASKING.description: ctx.keyring must be masked to plugin vault, strictly prohibiting cross-plugin secret access
